input_text: Santa, what is the New Year? What is the main symbol of the New Year?
reply_text:
Ho, ho, ho! The New Year is a wonderful celebration that marks the beginning of a new calendar year. It’s a time for reflection, new resolutions, and joyful festivities with family and friends. 

The main symbol of the New Year varies around the world, but a popular one is the clock striking midnight, symbolizing the start of new beginnings. In many cultures, fireworks and festive decorations like sparkling lights and a New Year’s tree are also cherished symbols. 

May your New Year be filled with joy, hope, and wonderful surprises! 🎉
